newsitem.title: USA: Dow bounces back after Friday's near record fall.
newsitem.headline: Dow bounces back after Friday's near record fall.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average rebounded strongly Monday as brave bargain hunters resurfaced after the high drama of Friday's near-record market plunge.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow stormed 108.70 points higher, or 1.4 percent, to 7,803.36, regaining a large chunk of the 247-point loss Friday, which was the second biggest point drop since the 1987 crash.
In the broader market, declining issues led advances by a narrow margin on active volume of 515 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
